title: Rational and common-field Weil comparison coherence
statement: Fix $D,C,E$ and the higher rational and common-field stages of the six-functor datum. Define rational Frobenius as the recorded geometric-Frobenius pullback. Rational lift data consist of the specified pull, direct, support, exceptional and tensor Frobenius isomorphisms; pullback/tensor have their canonical components, direct/exceptional are the specified adjunction mates, and support has its prescribed geometric compactification normalization. They induce functors on fixed Weil pairs. Define adjunction coherence by the actual unit and counit equations for these mates. Define $\operatorname{RationalCoherence}(A,L)$ and $\operatorname{CommonCoherence}(A,L)$ by the following comparisons retaining their exact underlying carriers: ordinary and exceptional adjunctions, pull/direct composition, support compactification comparison and composition, exceptional composition, ordinary and compact exchange and the projection map. Each lifted transformation has the specified carrier; invertibility is required precisely when the original comparison is invertible. The common-field version uses the existing common lift data. These are predicates; no lift-existence theorem is included. The constituent notions are [def-fix-six-functor-datum] [def-sf-operation-stages] [def-pod-constructible-weil-model-squares] [def-sf-constructible-common-stage-data] [def-pod-weil-lift-interfaces] [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] [def-exchange-projection].
